items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I heard about it... I asked about you one time... He's a first-rate photographer.

ctx.x: Well, I heard about it. What? Yeah, somebody said that you were taking a lot of pictures in New York. I asked about you one time. It was Bob Scobie, I think, when New Yorker, Turk 1. Saw you around here taking a whole lot of pictures. Oh, that and there's your head again. He's a first-rate photographer.
There's no one who's known as Weegee around town.
Did you have to walk in there just to have a picture? Yeah, that big knee you see come into the picture.
